title: Use external URL for all PWA home-screen icon sizes

requirements.summary: Replace PWA manifest home-screen icon sources with the provided external image URL for all required sizes/purposes.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest` has three icon entries (192x192, 512x512 any, 512x512 maskable) whose `src` is the provided external URL.
No remaining `/assets/generated/pwa-icon...` references exist in the manifest `icons` array.
After building and loading the app, the manifest served by the app reflects the updated icon `src` values.

file_operations.description: Update the `icons` array so the three required entries (192x192 purpose:any, 512x512 purpose:any, 512x512 purpose:maskable) all set `src` to exactly `https://blob.caffeine.ai/v1/blob/?blob_hash=sha256%3A5e8468951155e9387499978e83162188afd39a6d2ce119a1b96650eded40facf&owner_id=bjzp7-xyaaa-aaaaf-qbsta-cai&project_id=0198d89b-d4eb-711d-abfd-9b50202a1152`, and remove any remaining `/assets/generated/pwa-icon...` references from the manifest icons.
